title: Method of the Ziyarat of the chief of the Martyrs
categoryChain: Method of the Ziyarat of the chief of the Martyrs
introduction:
METHOD OF THE ZIYARAT OF THE CHIEF OF THE MARTYRS

We should know that two types of Ziarats have been recorded for Imam Husain (a.s.). One is that which can be recited anytime and others that can be recited only on particular occasions. We shall mention these Ziarats in three headings.
